##### Project general facts

Samana Lake Views 2 is a beautifully conceived residential tower that brings together tranquil elegance and modern sophistication in one striking address. Designed as a serene private escape, the building makes a bold architectural statement with its sculptural curved facade, generous glazing and meticulous attention to every detail. Homes are offered as thoughtfully planned studios, one bedroom and two bedroom residences, and the signature touch here is that they come with their very own private pool.

Life at Samana Lake Views 2 revolves around a wonderfully generous collection of leisure amenities, led by a stunning resort-style swimming pool surrounded by sun loungers, shaded cabanas and elegant outdoor lounge seating. Residents can also enjoy a fully equipped indoor gymnasium and a separate open-air fitness zone, a basketball court, a golf simulator, landscaped lawns for outdoor yoga and relaxation, and dedicated play space for children. Everyday convenience is elevated by a grand double-height arrival lobby with reception, professional valet parking, electric vehicle charging bays and smart home technology woven throughout the building.

Step inside and the interiors feel calm, contemporary and effortlessly refined, with open-plan living and dining spaces bathed in natural light from floor-to-ceiling windows. Kitchens are finished with sleek handleless cabinetry, integrated appliances, statement stone countertops and warm concealed lighting, flowing naturally into the living area with its textured feature walls and elegant panelled detailing. The bathrooms are equally impressive, dressed in large-format stone surfaces with backlit mirrors, matte black designer fittings, walk-in rain showers and beautiful timber accents that lend a real sense of quality throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Production City, formerly known as International Media Production Zone (IMPZ), is a vibrant and specialized community located in Dubai. It is designed to cater to the needs of the media production industry, offering a range of services, facilities, and infrastructure to support the production of print, publishing, and media content.

The community of Dubai Production City is designed to foster creativity, collaboration, and innovation. It offers a range of amenities and services to support the needs of professionals, including commercial spaces, offices, and retail outlets. The community also hosts events, workshops, and networking opportunities that encourage knowledge sharing, skill development, and growth.

Dubai Production City is well-connected to other key areas of Dubai, with easy access to major highways and public transportation networks. Its strategic location ensures convenient connectivity to business districts, residential areas, and cultural landmarks, making it an attractive destination for professionals and residents alike.
